item.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign among corruption allegations
item.description: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign as US ambassador to Greece following allegations that she sought payment from a Trump donor in exchange for access to administration officials
item.content:encoded: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign as US ambassador to Greece following allegations that she sought payment from a Trump donor in exchange for access to administration officials

item.title: Why does Pete Hegseth want to livestream an execution?
item.description: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has proposed livestreaming the execution of a man convicted of the 2009 attack on Fort Hood. Some scholars say the idea is rooted in his religious background.
item.content:encoded: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has proposed livestreaming the execution of a man convicted of the 2009 attack on Fort Hood. Some scholars say the idea is rooted in his religious background.

item.title: Bipartisan group of senators call on Trump to rescind Russian diesel deal
item.description: Six Democratic and six Republican senators wrote a letter calling on President Trump to withdraw from his recent deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

item.title: A judge blocks the government's tree-clearing spree at a municipal D.C. golf course
item.description: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.

item.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
item.description: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

item.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
item.description: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
item.description: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

item.title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
item.description: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Montana ballot measure could undo ruling on corporate spending in state politics
item.description: Montana voters will have a chance to speak out on the boom of corporate and anonymous money in politics that has been the result of the Citizens United court ruling.

item.title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
item.description: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.
